description: Batch event imports posted to the Mixpanel /import endpoint. /track is vendor/mixpanel. /engage is vendor/mixpanel-engage. /groups is vendor/mixpanel-groups. Auth is a header or basic auth, not a JSON field.

params.name: strict
params.description: Mixpanel documents `strict=1` so the batch is validated and failed events are named in the response.

params.name: project_id
params.description: It is the Mixpanel project id. Mixpanel requires it for service-account auth, and token auth may omit it.
params.fix_hint: Send `project_id` with a service account, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: event
params.description: Mixpanel documents the event name as required on every imported event.

params.name: properties
params.description: Mixpanel documents the properties object as required. `time`, `distinct_id`, and `$insert_id` ride inside it.

params.name: properties.time
params.description: Mixpanel documents `time` as required Unix seconds or milliseconds since epoch.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds or milliseconds since epoch, as an integer.

params.name: properties.distinct_id
params.description: Mixpanel documents `distinct_id` as required. An empty string is allowed for events that are not tied to a user. Placeholder values such as `null` or `0` are rejected.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `distinct_id` you use elsewhere for this user, or an empty string when there is no user.

params.name: properties.$insert_id
params.description: Mixpanel documents `$insert_id` as required so `/import` can be retried without double-counting. It must be at most 36 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.
params.fix_hint: Send a unique id per event, at most 36 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.

params.name: properties.ip
params.description: Mixpanel uses `ip` for GeoIP. Send a client address, or `0` to skip lookup. Do not hash it.
params.fix_hint: Send the visitor IP, or `0` from a server.

params.name: properties.$current_url
params.description: It is the URL of the page on which the event was tracked. Mixpanel documents `$current_url` on the JavaScript SDK default-property table.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `properties.$current_url`, including the scheme.

params.name: properties.$referrer
params.description: It is the referring URL, including your own domain. Mixpanel documents `$referrer` on the JavaScript SDK default-property table.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute referring URL, or omit the field when there is no referrer.

params.name: properties.mp_lib
params.description: It names the Mixpanel library that sent the event, such as `web`, `android`, or `swift`. Mixpanel documents `mp_lib` on the SDK default-property table.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.mp_lib`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.$lib_version
params.description: It is the Mixpanel library version. Mixpanel documents `$lib_version` on the SDK default-property table.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$lib_version`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.$device_id
params.description: It is the device-local Mixpanel ID. Mixpanel documents `$device_id` as regenerated by `reset()`.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$device_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.$user_id
params.description: It is the identified user ID. Mixpanel documents `$user_id` as set by `identify()`.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$user_id` after identify, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.$screen_height
params.description: It is the device screen height in pixels, or points on iOS. Mixpanel documents `$screen_height` on the SDK default-property table.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$screen_height` as an integer pixel or point count.

params.name: properties.$screen_width
params.description: It is the device screen width in pixels, or points on iOS. Mixpanel documents `$screen_width` on the SDK default-property table.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$screen_width` as an integer pixel or point count.

params.name: properties.$city
params.description: It is the city Mixpanel parses from `ip`, or a city you set yourself. Mixpanel documents `$city` on the ingestion GeoIP table.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$city`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.$region
params.description: It is the region Mixpanel parses from `ip`, or a region you set yourself. Mixpanel documents `$region` on the ingestion GeoIP table.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.$region`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: properties.mp_country_code
params.description: It is the country Mixpanel parses from `ip`. Mixpanel documents a 2-letter country code.
params.fix_hint: Send `properties.mp_country_code` as a two-letter code, such as `US`.

rules.message: The identifier is a placeholder Mixpanel rejects. `/import` disallows values such as `null`, `0`, `anonymous`, and the all-zero UUID.
rules.fix_hint: Send a real `distinct_id` or `$insert_id`, or an empty `distinct_id` when there is no user.

rules.message: `properties.ip` looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Mixpanel documents it as an IP address, or `0` to skip GeoIP.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address, or `0`.
